results.title: Pinellas County Aerial with Parcels 2023
results.description: Provides a consumer representation of parcel information that can be used with infrastructure and parcel information. The layers in the map provide context for multiple workflows, such as editing data or producing web maps. Includes structures, roads, major facilities and landmarks, water features, parcels, addresses and boundaries. This basemap uses design elements found in the General Purpose basemap but adds additional content at larger scales.

results.title: Pinellas County Parcel Label Point
results.description:
Pinellas County Florida Property Parcel Spatial Data, including the Parcel Identification number attribute.

Matching DOR Mapping data use the field PARCELNO

Matching DOR Tabular data use the field PARCEL_ID

Matching Property Appraiser download files use the field STRAP

Matching Property Appraiser Web Site or Parcel Tax Viewer use the field PARCELID
results.snippet: To provide a spatial representation of the Parcel property in Pinellas County, Florida.
